notes.title: 1.6.5 Release
notes.notes:
Fixes crashes caused by loading audio files on some systems. Fixed audio placement. Thank you all for your support!

Wade

notes.title: 1.6.2 Release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This update addresses a weird edge case where some videos would be an odd number of pixels wide or high; this also includes the fixes from 1.6.1 where transcoding was first introduced to fix unsupported pixel formats as well as a weird rounding error that would lock up the video clip generation process.

Thanks,
Wade
